description:
FILED s440 from agent A's #463 report (pre-existing on an item-2-only tree). Repro: `my $x=5; my $r=\$x; my $rr=\$r; print $$ {$rr}, "\n";` -> perl "" (undef element of %$), PCL "The variable %$ is unbound" at load. Same family as #449 (CL-unsafe punctuation containers: `%$` needs a pipe-quoted or runtime-owned cell -- #498 made the punctuation ARRAYS runtime-owned; the HASH siblings `%$` `%!` `%+` `%-` ... -- `%+`/`%-` already are; measure which punctuation HASHES perl allows and own them the same way). Bar: the repro + `%$` read/write across two packages (main:: everywhere) + the ARRAY twin `@$` if legal; a Pl/t guard row beside punct-array-glob-01.t.

DONE (s446j, agent J).  Cause: nothing declared the container.  A punctuation name is legal perl for EVERY character (measured char by char on 5.40.3 -- only `$^[0]` is a syntax error, because `$^` wants a letter, and `#` starts a comment), and PCL was unbound for 25 of the hashes and 15 more of the arrays: the twelve of #415/#498 were the set ONE repair happened to cover, not the set perl allows.  Only a READ shows it -- a write auto-vivifies through p-setf's simple-symbol arm -- and the read is a bare CL symbol nobody declared, so the file dies at LOAD before line 1 runs.  Fix: the runtime OWNS them (defvar + export from :pcl, the @-/@+ way #498 chose, because perlvar forces a punctuation name into package main -- a write in one package and a read in another meet).  The emitter already pipe-quotes the CL-unsafe ones (|%;| |%:| |%\||), verified symbol by symbol against the emission.  Guard: Pl/t/punct-array-glob-01.t 31 -> 34 rows (perl oracle).
RESIDUE, filed as #550: the WHOLE-CONTAINER spellings (`keys %$`, `%? = (...)`) still drop -- PPI lexes `%?` as Operator+Operator and _merge_punct_array_symbols repairs only the `@` half, because `%` is ambiguous with modulo.  NOTE FOR #449: its stated blocker ("the rest would need a pipe-quoted emission, which is its own emission rule") is GONE -- the emitter pipe-quotes already and the runtime now owns every character, so widening %PUNCT_ARRAY_CHARS is unblocked.
subject: `$$ {EXPR}` (PID magic, a SPACE, then braces) emits an UNBOUND CL symbol `%$` and kills the whole file at LOAD -- perl: an element of the hash %$ (undef); the #415/#449 family (punctuation-named containers need a forward declaration / pipe-quoted emission)
